# Thomas H. Glocer to Retire From Merck Board of Directors in May 2027; Douglas M. Baker, Jr. Appointed Independent Lead Director


[Save](https://s2.q4cdn.com/584635680/files/doc_news/Thomas-H--Glocer-to-Retire-From-Merck-Board-of-Directors-in-May-2027-Douglas-M--Baker-Jr--Appointed-Independent-Lead-Director-2026.pdf)


November 18, 2026 6:45 am EST


RAHWAY, N.J.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Merck (NYSE: MRK), known as MSD outside the United States and Canada, today announced that Thomas H. Glocer intends to retire from the Merck Board of Directors at the Company’s Annual Meeting of Shareholders in May 2027. The independent members of the Board have appointed Douglas M. Baker, Jr., as independent lead director, effective Jan. 1, 2027, succeeding Mr. Glocer in the role.


Mr. Baker has served on the Merck Board of Directors since 2022. He has wide-ranging expertise in corporate governance and organizational management, including a deep understanding of global marketing, sales and operations of public companies. Previously, Mr. Baker was chairman and chief executive officer of Ecolab Inc., a provider of water and hygiene services and technologies for the food, hospitality, industrial and energy markets. He is also a trustee of Mayo Clinic.


“Merck has counted on Tom’s expertise and counsel as a trusted voice in our boardroom for many years, and I have relied on him as a valued collaborator. His contributions to our Company have been invaluable, and on behalf of everyone at Merck, I thank him for his dedicated service,” said Rob Davis, chairman and chief executive officer, Merck. “As we look ahead, Doug is a thoughtful, experienced and accomplished leader who will undoubtedly serve the Board well in this expanded role. I look forward to our continued work together as we deliver value to our stakeholders.”


**About Merck**


At Merck, known as MSD outside of the United States and Canada, we are unified around our purpose: We use the power of leading-edge science to save and improve lives around the world. For more than 130 years, we have brought hope to humanity through the development of important medicines and vaccines. We aspire to be the premier research-intensive biopharmaceutical company in the world – and today, we are at the forefront of research to deliver innovative health solutions that advance the prevention and treatment of diseases in people and animals. We foster a diverse global workforce and operate responsibly every day to enable a safe, sustainable and healthy future for all people and communities.
